blocks.title: Fence along a river
blocks.problem: Use 120 m of fence for three sides of a rectangle along a straight river. Maximize area.

steps.title: Write the constraint
steps.why: Only the side along the river is unfenced.

steps.title: Build the objective
steps.why: The derivative now uses one independent dimension.

steps.title: Optimize
steps.md: $A^\prime=120-4w$ vanishes at 30. The endpoints both give zero area.
steps.why: Comparing all candidates proves a global maximum.

blocks.title: Minimize material for a cylinder
blocks.problem: A closed cylinder holds $54\pi$ cm$^3$. Find the radius and height that minimize surface area.

steps.title: Find the stationary point
steps.why: The denominator is positive and the numerator crosses zero.

steps.title: Prove and interpret
steps.md: The derivative changes from negative to positive across 3. Then $h=54/9=6$.
steps.why: The whole positive domain is covered by the sign test.

blocks.title: Closest point on a parabola
blocks.problem: Find the points on $y=x^2$ nearest to $(0,3)$.

steps.title: Write squared distance
steps.why: Minimizing the square preserves the order of distances.

steps.title: Compare
steps.md: Squared distance is 9 at zero and $11/4$ at the other two. It tends to infinity at both ends.
steps.why: The two equal smaller values are global minima.
